payload.claim: UK visas that need English accept only a SELT from an approved provider, taken at an approved location, with result within two years before applying
payload.quote: You must take it at an approved test location, and you must receive the result within two years before you apply.

payload.claim: IELTS for UKVI (Academic) is an approved SELT
payload.quote: IELTS SELT Consortium: IELTS for UKVI (Academic or General Training) and IELTS Life Skills.

payload.claim: PTE Academic UKVI is an approved SELT
payload.quote: Pearson: PTE Academic UKVI and PTE Home.

payload.claim: LanguageCert International ESOL SELT is an approved SELT
payload.quote: LanguageCert: International ESOL SELT, Academic SELT and General SELT.

payload.claim: Degree-level Student visa needs CEFR B2; universities may assess English themselves so can accept non-SELT tests
payload.quote: For degree-level study on a Student visa you need English at CEFR B2.

payload.claim: TOEFL iBT is not a SELT but many UK universities accept it for degree admission
payload.quote: It is not on the SELT list. Many UK universities still accept it for degree-level admission, because they are allowed to assess your English themselves.

payload.claim: PTE Academic UKVI results often within 48 hours
payload.quote: Applicants looking for a fast and efficient testing process with quick results (often within 48 hours)

payload.claim: In 2018, 85.7% of PTE Academic takers received results within 2 days
payload.quote: In fact, during 2018, 85.7% of PTE Academic test takers received their results within just 2 days.

payload.claim: Some PTE results take longer than 2 days due to review or security checks
payload.quote: Our system sometimes flags results for additional review which can take more time.

payload.claim: IELTS accepted by over 13,500 organisations vs around 3,000 for PTE
payload.quote: In fact, over 13,500 organisations worldwide trust IELTS’ evaluation of English language skills while only around 3,000 organisations accept the PTE.

payload.claim: PTE is computer-only whereas IELTS offers paper or computer in many locations
payload.quote: This is because the PTE is available only on computer, whereas with IELTS you will have the flexibility to choose between taking your test on computer or paper in many locations globally.

payload.claim: UKVI versions have the same content and format as standard tests
payload.quote: IELTS for UKVI and PTE Academic UKVI have the same content and format as the standard tests, so our IELTS and PTE Academic practice tests prepare you for them.

payload.claim: Pearson states PTE Academic UKVI is accepted by Home Office for all UK visas
payload.quote: Our Secure English Language test, PTE Academic UKVI, is accepted by the UK’s Home Office for all UK visas to test your four language skills – including the Skilled Worker visa.

payload.claim: A normal IELTS cannot be used where a SELT is required
payload.quote: No. For a visa that needs a SELT, you must book IELTS for UKVI (or IELTS Life Skills) at an approved centre.
